name: html-newsletter-form-readable
description: Converts a safe newsletter email signup form into readable editable blocks without preserving it as a runtime form fallback.

source_reference.notes: Covers the raw HTML corpus mockup newsletter form shape: email input plus implicit submit button with an inline submit handler but no real action target.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.

input.content: <form class="news__form" onsubmit="return mcSignup(event)"> <input type="email" required placeholder="your@email.fr" aria-label="Email address"> <button class="btn">Subscribe</button> </form>
